requirements.location: Complete analysis/outline.md, all 36 lines: research question/selection, all eight report-structure items, production-unit scope and necessary-source/calculation limits.
requirements.basis: I actually read the complete original task, effective requirements and this entire outline in my independent requirements context. The outline selects seven traceable small-molecule cases by documented contribution and outcome, including stops and inconclusive cases, and explicitly limits census/success-rate inference. It makes candidate–indication–formulation the unit; resolves aliases and inherited molecules; distinguishes event, publication and registry dates and clinical milestones at the cutoff. Structure items 2–5 cover the computational-to-laboratory feedback chain, human decisions, prospective versus retrospective evidence, new molecules versus repurposing, trial designs/populations/endpoints and stopped programs. Item 6 requires like-stage comparisons, clocks, prior exposure, selection, censoring and inspectable denominators. Item 7 covers data/candidate/platform rights, experimental roles, decision/handoff responsibilities, scope, feedback and distinct payment categories. Item 8 plans every required evidence-chain, clinical/stage and partnership exhibit plus conditional decisions. Source work names concrete missing originals and distinguishes missing access from undisclosed evidence; calculation rules preserve denominators and adjusted versus raw estimates. This is an outline-scope pass, not a claim that the outline alone supplies a completed final report. The historical reviewer/producer-overlap issue is addressed by a new substantive assessment performed by /root/complete_requirements_b, who has not produced or edited this outline or report; the invalid old record remains historical.
